paragraphs: One of the biggest consequences of tree growth is that of brush forming below your trees. When trees begin to shed their leaves, or needles, those things fall to the ground below the trees. If this isn’t picked up, and maintained, it creates a thick blanket of muck. What’s worse, if it rains on top of it, this created a nearly unmanageable mess. To remedy this, we can come out and make sure that your brush is regularly cleaned. Let our brush cleaning services be a routine part of your tree maintenance. Controlled BurnsOne of the ways that we can effectively remove all of your brush is to do controlled burns. In this process, we will get clearance from your local fire department and block out a burn radius. Once that is taken care of, we will put up protective barriers so that the flames do not jump to anywhere that we do not want them to go. Once all protections are in place, we will go about burning your brush; turning it to a more manageable ash. This ash can then be shoveled up, and disposed of properly. Brush RemovalIf we do not get a clearance to burn in your area, brush will need to be removed of in a more systematic way. Without a burn, we can remove brush with shovels, machetes and a host of other tools. If the brush is not too thick, we can simply rake it up and dispose of it. However, if you haven’t had your brush cleaned in a good while, it will need to be broken down, either with the chopping of a blade, or shovel. Once the brush is broken down, it is easier to bag up and get rid of. Tree CareOf course, brush is the result of not taking care of your trees properly. With regular pruning, most brush can be avoided. We have a lot of experience in this field, and we know how to assess what kind of leaves and needles are ready to be removed and shed. By pruning your trees, we can make sure that only the minimum amount of brush makes it to the ground. Having only little amounts of brush to pick up, and get rid of, makes the job a lot quicker for us, and cheaper for you! Consequences of Not RemovingIf you are not removing brush from the ground, you are stacking the odds against your safety. Because we have incredibly hot temperatures in Florida, uncared for brush present a pretty big risk of fire. Brush is highly flammable and, should even one, little piece of it ignite, it can cause a devastating fire. For this reason, we highly encourage you to have routine brush clean ups done. Beyond that, even in rainy season, leftover brush can become a nuisance. Thick brush, when wet, creates a heavy blanket of filth that looks unkempt and can be a real eyesore on your property.

paragraphs: We do not only offer residential tree services. In fact, a lot of the work that we do, with tress, is commercial servicing. In commercial projects, tree removal can actually be even more important, because, generally, tree removal in this setting is used when a new commercial property is being built. Because trees cannot be built on top of, they must be removed to give even surfaces to build upon. Tree root systems are also, often, expansive and can cause issues for things like cabling and piping systems. Commercial Tree RemovalIf you are the owner of a soon to be commercial building, or a commercial property, and need trees removed, we are your team! We can remove single trees, if that’s all that is needed, or we can remove full tree growths. If you are attempting to completely clear out land, so that you can build on top of it, let us know and we can get to work immediately. We will make sure that any tree, no matter how big, is completely removed, so that your commercial property is ready for whatever is coming to it next. Commercial Stump RemovalIf you have had trees cut down in the past, but are now plagues with a small forest of stumps, we can remove these as well. While stumps may not seem like that big of an issue, just like trees, they cannot simply be built on top of. This means that stumps also need to go. We can bring in heavy machinery that will make quick work of your stumps; pulling them out and disposing of them. We can also fill in any voids that are created by the stump pull; ensuring that you can excavate, or build, as appropriate. Commercial TrimmingOne of the best things that you can do for a commercial property that has trees on it is to keep your tress trimmed. Branches, that are getting out of control in length, can cause issues for businesses or apartment units. Beyond that, if branches become too heavy for the tree, they risk the consequence of snapping and falling down. This can cause problems for structures underneath, or for people moving about the property. We can even schedule regular tree trimming maintenance, so that it is never something you need to think about! Commercial Root RemovalCommercial root removal is absolutely imperative if you are looking to build a new commercial building. Root systems are vicious, and they will grow through absolutely anything that you lay down around them. For this reason, it is very important that root systems are completely removed prior to building. While you are in the process of excavation, we can work hand in hand with your construction company to effectively remove any roots that may be growing. We assure you that, with our techniques and tools, we will make sure that roots, growing out of hand, are not something you need to worry about in the future.

paragraphs: Tree removal, trimming and care is imperative to the safety of your property. If you have a property, whether it is residential or commercial, and it has trees on it, you need to take the proper precautions to make sure that those trees grow strong, without becoming a hazard to anyone, or anything. Because Florida has hot summers, which cause trees to grow rapidly, and cold winters, that bring massive storms, trees are something that always need to be kept an eye on. If you have trees on your property, let us be the company to take care of them.

About UsWe are the number one tree removal, and care, professionals in the Port St Lucie area. We are committed to providing you with the best tree maintenance service around. We are outgoing, friendly and incredibly hard working and we assure you that we can take care of anything tree related that you need done. We have worked hard to build a great reputation for ourselves and we stand by our services. We charge fair prices and we employ the most efficient tree service professionals in the business. If you need us, we are there.

We try and provide as many tree related services as we can think of. We do this so that we can always say yes, when you need our help. The services that we are currently providing are: tree services, tree removal, tree trimming, tree cutting, stump removal, stump grinding, tree pruning, commercial tree services, residential tree services, brush cleaning and storm debris clean up. As you can see, we try and cover the full spectrum for you. If you think you have a job for us, that isn’t listed here, please reach out still and let us talk with you about it!

If you have trees on your property that need to be removed, we can take care of that business for you. If your trees are large, and dead, we can cut them down and then fully remove the stump and root systems. If you would like to try and keep a live tree in tact, we can do our best to pull it out and relocate it.

If you have already had trees cut down in the past, but you still have their stumps on your property, and want them removed, we have you covered. Depending on the size of the stump, and its root system, we can do one of two things: we can either winch and pull your stump out of the ground, or we can grind it down, cutting in to pieces to remove it.

If you happen to have a commercial property that needs tree or stump removal services, we can also do that. In commercial properties, especially areas where buildings are being planned, removing trees, stumps, and their corresponding roots systems, is massively important to properly install all manner of things. Trees and stumps prohibit structures from being built. Expansive root systems can encroach in to cabling or piping systems and cause massive issues, if not taken care of.

If you are letting trees, on your property, grow then preventative care is necessary. Pruning is one of the number one care options that we offer. Because tree foliage grows rapidly, keeping it in check is vital to tree health. Likewise, if branches begin to die, or become too heavy, they can break off, causing harm. In order to rectify this, we can trim your branches; keeping your tree safe.

When leaves and needles fall off of trees, they collect around the base of the tree. Because there is nowhere for this brush to go, it becomes a matted, tangled mess. This presents a really big hazard in Florida: brush is extremely flammable. If even one little piece of brush ignites, it can cause all of your brush to go up in flames. For this reason, we can regularly clean your brush up for you.

The one bad thing about living in Florida is that, at some point, we will have storms come through. If these storms are big enough, the winds they bring will create a major hazard for the trees on your property. Heavy winds can break off branches and, sometimes, completely knock down your trees. If a storm has come through, and blown debris everywhere, we can help pick it up for you.

If you have read through our services above and think that we may be able to take care of your trees, then now is the time to reach out and say “hi”. If you have trees on your property that need to be removed, we can take care of that business for you. If your trees are large, and dead, we can cut them down and then fully remove the stump and root systems. If you would like to try and keep a live tree in tact, we can do our best to pull it out and relocate it.

If you have already had trees cut down in the past, but you still have their stumps on your property, and want them removed, we have you covered. Depending on the size of the stump, and its root system, we can do one of two things: we can either winch and pull your stump out of the ground, or we can grind it down, cutting in to pieces to remove it.

If you happen to have a commercial property that needs tree or stump removal services, we can also do that. In commercial properties, especially areas where buildings are being planned, removing trees, stumps, and their corresponding roots systems, is massively important to properly install all manner of things. Trees and stumps prohibit structures from being built. Expansive root systems can encroach in to cabling or piping systems and cause massive issues, if not taken care of.

If you are letting trees, on your property, grow then preventative care is necessary. Pruning is one of the number one care options that we offer. Because tree foliage grows rapidly, keeping it in check is vital to tree health. Likewise, if branches begin to die, or become too heavy, they can break off, causing harm. In order to rectify this, we can trim your branches; keeping your tree safe.

When leaves and needles fall off of trees, they collect around the base of the tree. Because there is nowhere for this brush to go, it becomes a matted, tangled mess. This presents a really big hazard in Florida: brush is extremely flammable. If even one little piece of brush ignites, it can cause all of your brush to go up in flames. For this reason, we can regularly clean your brush up for you.

The one bad thing about living in Florida is that, at some point, we will have storms come through. If these storms are big enough, the winds they bring will create a major hazard for the trees on your property. Heavy winds can break off branches and, sometimes, completely knock down your trees. If a storm has come through, and blown debris everywhere, we can help pick it up for you.

If you have read through our services above and think that we may be able to take care of your trees, then now is the time to reach out and say “hi”. You can use our main number to cal our offices whenever you would like. If you call during business hours, we can almost always get you over to a live person to help you out. If you’d prefer to go the computer route, you can use our included, easy to fill out contact form to shoot us over a message. We can’t wait to talk to you.

paragraphs: Florida is a great state to live in and, most of the time, we have incredibly beautiful weather. However, one of the few drawbacks is that Florida is prone to storms sweeping through. While most of these storms will do little damage, save for intense rain, some will wreak havoc. If a storm moves through, with strong winds, it is very likely that any trees that you have on your property will be rocked pretty hard. These types of storms can lead to all sorts of debris being blown about. Fallen LimbsFallen limbs are one of the main consequences of a storm passing through your property. While larger branches may be able to withstand, even the heaviest of winds, smaller branches will not. When the wind is too much for branches to handle, it will cause them to splinter, break and blow in to your property. This can cause harm to other things on your property, but hopefully it doesn’t. If you are noticing several branches, strewn about, after a storm passes through, give us a call so that we can come and clean up for you. Needle and Leaf CleanupNeedles and leaves from trees are things that absolutely cannot withstand storm winds. Heavy rains and winds will cause these things to dislodge and fall to the ground en masse. As these pieces of debris fall, they will, no doubt, get caught up in the winds and be blown all over. Raking and cleaning this type of debris up can take a long time. For this reason, we would love to be the people to do it for you. Rather than take time out of your schedule to rake up all the leaves and needles that are spread out over your property, let us take care of it for you. Broken TreesBroken trees are a little harder to clean up after a storm. If the storm was big enough to knock over fully grown trees, you may be having other things to worry about. If this is the case, please let us know so that you can get back to taking care of yourself, and let us worry about the trees. If trees are completely down, we can cut them in to pieces, for you to use, or help in selling them to companies that will buy them from you, to use in other products. Other DebrisThere is no telling what other kind of debris could be spread around after a storm. If you give us the call to come out and help, we can pick up anything that is not supposed to be there. While our focus is mainly on natural debris, we can assist in the cleaning up of nearly anything. With this process, we just want to make sure that your property is cleaned and that, as a result, you are kept safe. Anytime you need a storm clean up, let us be your first, and only, call.

og:title: Stump Removal, Affordable Tree Care Company, Port St Lucie, FL
og:description: If you have already had trees cut down in the past, but you still have their stumps on your property, and want them removed, we have you covered.

images.alt: stump left behind after tree got removed

paragraphs: If you have already had trees cut down, but you have stumps littering your property, it could be beneficial to you to have those stumps removed. If the stump is a live stump, this means that, whatever tree was growing from it, could grow back. It may take a while, but over time, you will then be faced with the same problem. Stumps can also present hazards to vehicles driving through your property, or people walking, as they could be tripping hazards. Pulling StumpsOne of the easiest ways to get your stump out of the ground, is to pull it out. In this removal process, we use a winch system (if available), or a chain, which is wrapped around the stump and then tied to a heavy vehicle. Once the winch/chain is secured, the vehicle will drive forward; slowly ripping the stump from the ground. This process usually takes a few tries, as the goal is to not cause damage to the vehicle. Depending on the root system of the stump, this process may be relatively painless, or it may take a good amount of work. Digging OutIf the stump that you are trying to remove is a smaller stump, it may be possible to dig it out of the ground. The benefit of this process is that, because the excavation is controlled, shovels and saws can be used to cut through any existing root systems. This means that the stump will, for sure, be eradicated and a tree will not grow back. This process typically also leaves a much smaller hole. And, because digging a stump out can be done by hand, this eliminates the need for machinery, heavy vehicles and a winch system. Benefits of RemovalThe benefits of stump removal are plentiful. Removing a stump means that the tree, which it belonged to, will not grow back. Removing the stump, effectively kills whatever was growing in that location. Removing a stump can also allow for the ground surrounding it to be level and smooth; which means that vehicles can access it without worrying about ruining tired or undercarriages. In addition, taking stumps out of the ground, can eliminate the risk of people tripping over them, and hurting themselves in the process. Lastly, removing stumps makes for a much more beautiful landscape; giving nice, open views of your property, without obstructions. Uses for WoodOne of the great things about stump removal is that, once removed, you have an excess of wood. This wood can be used for a few different things. If the wood is not rotten, it can be sectioned, and then sold, to wood companies. Depending on the amount of wood you get, this could lead to some tidy profits. If you aren’t in the business of selling the wood, the stumps can also be cut down, and then used as firewood during the colder winter months. If neither of these options appeal to you, we can simply dispose of the stump for you.

images.alt: tree care expert working on planting tree

paragraphs: If you have a property that has trees on it now, or you are planning on growing trees, preventative care is absolutely necessary. If you currently have tress growing, taking care of them so that they don’t die, and then cause harm to your poverty or person, is extremely important. If you are planting new trees, and trying to get them to grow nicely, protecting them so that they can get full-sized should be a priority. No matter what type of care you are needing, we are there for you. PruningIf you are lucky enough to have your trees in bloom, and the foliage is getting bigger, and bigger, it may be time to bring us in to prune. While a nice, full, canopy can make your trees look absolutely beautiful, it can also cause issues. Dry leaves falling can create fire hazards on the ground. Leaves stacking up can also increase the load weight of branches, eventually making them snap and plummet to the ground below. For these reasons, keeping your canopy properly prunes is an essential part of tree ownership. Branch RemovalBranch removal, and trimming, goes hand in hand with pruning. As branches become bigger, and the foliage they carry, becomes more dense, more stress is put on to the branch. While, typically, branches can support themselves, outside forces, such as rain or wind, can cause this stress to amplify. When that happens, branches can snap and break off. This is a major danger for anything, or anyone, around your trees. In order to remediate this situation, the best thing to do is to have branches trimmed and maintained. Likewise, if we assess that certain branches have died, they should immediately be removed, completely, or run the risk of falling off. MulchingMulching is a process in which mulch is paced at the base of your tree to help it grow strong. In this process, leaves are usually raked away from the gas of your tree and the top layer of earth is dug out around the trunk. Once this happens, We use mulch to fill in that depression. Mulch helps to properly siphon water through, to your trunks root system. Mulch also helps to protect the base of the trunk, and keep is sturdy. Mulching newer trees will be a huge benefit to having them grow quickly. Small Tree ProtectionAnother service that we offer is the protection of small trees. Because saplings are prime treats for all manner of critters, it is important to have them protected while they are trying to grow. These tiny trees are also at the mercy of nearly any inclement weather system. For these reasons, young trees need a little hep to fully grow up. We can come in and build a cage around your tree; effectively blocking out would be predators. We can also install a brace alongside your tree, so that it will stand up through winds.

paragraphs: If you have a property that contains several trees, there will, no doubt, come a time when one, or several, of those trees need to be removed. Because this process can be extremely stressful and difficult, we are here to help you. Trees may need to be removed for a number of reasons. If trees die, they can become dangerous to their surroundings. If trees are partially upended by a storm, they may need to be fully taken down. Also, if you just want to have a more clear view, this is another great reason. Cutting/Pulling RootsThe process of removing a tree can be approached in may different ways. One of the ways we can go about removing a tree, if it is a large tree, is to cut it down in to smaller pieces. This makes the the stump easier to work with, and remove. If the tree is small enough, we can usually attached a chain to it and pull it straight out of the ground with a large vehicle. Once pulled up, we will set about removing root systems, so that the tree is gone for good. Green RemovalIf you are green friendly, and the tree that we are removing is still alive, we can do our best to take it out of the ground alive. Rather than cut the tree down and remove it completely, we will do our bet to keep the tree fully in tact so that, when we remove it, we can place it on a truck and carry it to somewhere where it can be replanted. This is a great option because it helps with deforestation, and you have the added benefit of knowing that you are protecting the earth, while also beautifying your property. Dangers of Not RemovingIf you have trees that absolutely need to be removed, and you don’t remove them, this could cause serious issues. One of the biggest issues is that, if your tree is large, and dead, it could fall over, or branches could break off, leading to the destruction of property. This could also be hazardous to animals, or people, who may be around the tree. Another issues is that, if the tree is dying, and the roots are stretching in to other trees, this could cause other trees to start dying as well. BenefitsThe benefits of tree removal are numerous. First of all, if your tree is dying, removing it can be a very safe option; as the tree will no longer be a anger to you or your property. Secondly, if you are looking to beautify your property, removing trees could give you much better views and a more open feel. Thirdly, if you have us cut your tree down, in to wood sections, you may be able to sell those sections to wood companies for a profit. Lastly, if we remove the whole tree, it can be replanted elsewhere; making you feel good about the planet’s future.
